summary: After install, AAP is at https://<gateway_node>:443, logging in with gateway_admin_username/password; change ports with envoy_http_port and envoy_https_port or disable HTTPS with envoy_disable_https.
questions: What URL do I use to log in to AAP after install?
How do I change the AAP gateway ports?
How do I disable HTTPS on platform gateway?

answer_card.title: After installing
answer_card.answer_md:
- URL: `https://<gateway_node>:443`
- Log in with `gateway_admin_username` / `gateway_admin_password`
- Ports: `envoy_http_port=80`, `envoy_https_port=443`
- Disable HTTPS: `envoy_disable_https=true`
